source.dataset: County Presidential Election Returns 2000-2024 (official results from state election offices)

howToRead: Margin = Democratic share minus Republican share of all votes cast. +10 means the Democratic candidate led by 10 points; −10 means the Republican candidate did.
Third-party and write-in votes count toward the total, so the two shares add to less than 100%.
title: Presidential election results by county
description: How each county voted for president, 2000 to 2024, as the margin between the Democratic and Republican candidates.
caveats: A shaded map gives large, empty counties the same weight as big cities. The votes-cast fact and the bar view show where the voters are.
Alaska reports results by state house district, not county, so it shows as no data.
Certified results compiled by MIT Election Data + Science Lab; small differences from a state's own canvass are possible.
